title: A Static for the Archive
author: Emrys Thackeray
blurb: Cyrus Crane, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
